name: gr1-tabletop-cuttingboard-pan-n1d7-noise01-extension-64-v1
question: Does K=4, noise=0.1 satisfy the unchanged two-sided ODE/SDE equivalence gate after extending from 32 to 64 reset clusters?

extension_design.pairing: Each new ODE/SDE pair shares scenario, environment seed, policy seed, and initial Gaussian latent plan. The SHA-frozen 32-reset aggregate is combined with the new panel before inference.
extension_design.primary_interval: 10,000-sample paired cluster bootstrap over all 64 reset seeds

equivalence_gate.pass: Point estimate and reset-clustered 95% interval are wholly within [-0.10, 0.10].
equivalence_gate.reject: The clustered interval excludes the equivalence region on either side, or the absolute point estimate is at least 0.20.
equivalence_gate.inconclusive: Any result that is neither pass nor reject.

decision_rule.on_pass: Restart the one-task GRPO recipe from the unchanged SFT base with noise_level=0.1 as the only changed factor and evaluate through at least 20 updates.
decision_rule.on_reject: Do not optimize. Release GPUs and review denoise-step calibration.
decision_rule.on_inconclusive: Do not optimize or extend automatically. Release GPUs and review the admission design.
